metadata.llm_reason: Sequential Scale Configuration is a distinct capability focused on continuous-to-continuous interpolated mapping via d3.scaleSequential and its variants (Log, Pow, Sqrt, Symlog, Quantile). It differs from peer candidates: Quantile Scale (discrete output via equal-frequency binning), Logarithmic Scale (log-specific ticks/formatting), and Threshold Scale (discrete quantization via thresholds). The candidate addresses interpolator-based sequential mapping, which is a separate concern from the discrete or log-specific peers. No conflicts detected in support evidence.
